page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.13xlarge is an x86_64 instance type within the Enhanced instance family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provisioned using 52 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Backing the compute allocation is 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per dedicated vCPU. The instance does not feature hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

Network infrastructure on the ecs.g6t.13xlarge delivers a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps, supporting stable communication for distributed and inter-node architectures. There is no bundled local storage on this instance, requiring external block storage or remote network-attached filesystems for persistent state and operating system files. System administrators must factor in external storage throughput and latency when designing storage-heavy setups.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a high compute core count alongside a nearly standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, optimizing density for horizontally and vertically scaled business applications without the cost overhead of specialized memory-heavy or GPU hardware. The absence of local disk avoids charges for unused local drives while allowing precise right-sizing through attached cloud storage volumes.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.13xlarge is suited for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, medium-to-large relational database nodes, batch processing, enterprise application backends, and container orchestration clusters requiring balanced CPU and memory resources.
